```python
from solution import is_subset_sum


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example requires is_subset_sum([3, 34, 4, 12, 5, 2], 6, 9) == True."""
    assert is_subset_sum([3, 34, 4, 12, 5, 2], 6, 9) == True  # 4+5=9 so True


def test_issue_no_subset_returns_false():
    """No subset sums to target so result must be False."""
    assert is_subset_sum([3, 34, 4, 12, 5, 2], 6, 30) == False  # 3+4+12+5+2=26 <30, 34+2=36 >30 so False


def test_issue_total_sum_reachable():
    """Subset equal to whole set must be found."""
    assert is_subset_sum([1, 2, 3], 3, 6) == True  # 1+2+3=6 so True


def test_issue_single_element_match():
    """Single element equal to sum must be True."""
    assert is_subset_sum([5], 1, 5) == True  # 5=5 so True


def test_issue_single_element_mismatch():
    """Single element not equal to sum must be False."""
    assert is_subset_sum([5], 1, 4) == False  # subsets are 0 and 5, 0!=4 and 5!=4 so False


def test_issue_empty_set_zero_sum():
    """Empty subset sums to zero so ([], 0, 0) must be True."""
    assert is_subset_sum([], 0, 0) == True  # empty sum 0==0 so True


def test_issue_empty_set_nonzero_sum():
    """Empty set cannot sum to nonzero so ([], 0, 5) must be False."""
    assert is_subset_sum([], 0, 5) == False  # empty sum 0!=5 so False


def test_issue_zero_target_nonempty():
    """Empty subset sums to zero so target 0 must be True."""
    assert is_subset_sum([1, 2, 3], 3, 0) == True  # empty sum 0==0 so True


def test_issue_n_limits_to_first_n_elements():
    """Only first n elements count, so n=2 cannot reach 9."""
    assert is_subset_sum([3, 34, 4, 12, 5, 2], 2, 9) == False  # 3=3, 34=34, 3+34=37, none==9 so False


def test_issue_threshold_reachable():
    """Value at threshold 10 must be reachable from [5, 10]."""
    assert is_subset_sum([5, 10], 2, 10) == True  # 10=10 so True


def test_issue_threshold_just_above():
    """Value just above threshold 11 must not be reachable from [5, 10]."""
    assert is_subset_sum([5, 10], 2, 11) == False  # 5=5, 10=10, 5+10=15, none==11 so False


def test_contract_exact_true_object():
    """Result must be True object (not just truthy) when subset exists."""
    result = is_subset_sum([2, 3, 7], 3, 5)  # 2+3=5 so True
    assert result is True  # literal True, 2+3=5 so True


def test_contract_exact_false_object():
    """Result must be False object (not just falsy) when no subset exists."""
    result = is_subset_sum([2, 3, 7], 3, 6)  # 2=2, 3=3, 7=7, 2+3=5, 2+7=9, 3+7=10 so False
    assert result is False  # literal False, no combo==6 so False
```
